content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 13.5 (Shared Resources – Ownership) is a deviation from the IP rule at the fallback level. Corio owns Developments it creates and Commerce One assigns any claim it has (good), and Commerce One's retention of its pre-existing materials and the Software under 2.8 is acceptable. However, ownership flips wholly to Commerce One for any Development it supports on an ongoing basis, with no licence back to Corio, and ownership of Corio-created or jointly created Software enhancements is left to future negotiation — so for that category Corio holds no rights, failing the fallback licence requirement. No provision anywhere addresses Corio/Customer data.

**Redline (one inserted clause 13.5.1):** a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for Corio to use, modify and sublicense any such Commerce One-owned Developments/enhancements for its business, plus a limit confining any Commerce One licence in data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers to processing solely to provide the services.
